title: 16.22. Kusalattika, Cittānuparivattadukādi
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Kusalaṁ cittānuparivattiṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca … (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā terasa, ārammaṇe nava …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate terasa.
Kusalaṁ nocittānuparivattiṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca … (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā terasa, ārammaṇe nava …pe… vipāke tīṇi …pe… avigate terasa. (Ete saṅkhittā, dukattayaṁ cittadukasadisaṁ.)
